result.subject: Request for Lab Tour During Engineering Expedition
result.body:
Your research on motion planning under uncertainty at UC Berkeley has significantly influenced our understanding of adaptive control systems. We are a small group of engineering students visiting the San Francisco Bay Area to explore cutting-edge research in robotics and AI. We write to seek insights from your work.

We are particularly interested in your research on safe reinforcement learning and its applications in dynamic environments. Our group hopes to learn how these methods ensure robustness in uncertain settings, which is central to our project on autonomous navigation systems.

We would be honored to request a 30-minute lab tour during our visit. We are flexible and willing to adapt to your schedule. Your guidance would greatly enhance our understanding of your research and its practical implications.
